payload.title: role comments still say position
payload.body: Found while assaying stale-comments of docs-and-persona at b3cb9924. That commit replaced 'position' with the design's anchor 'role' in the comments of packages/canon/src/dimensions/role/{architect,implementer,integrator}.ts, but the same usage, 'position' meaning a role, is still in the comments of packages/canon/src/roles/{hold,architect,assayer,implementer,integrator,planner}.ts, packages/canon/src/agents/{implementer,integrator,planner,mav}.ts and packages/canon/src/hooks/purview-guardrail.ts. These comments are not false, but they spell the role concept with a word that is not its anchor. The files lie where persona-residue is working, so whichever unit owns them after it lands could bring the wording into line.
